test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error. **

More than 30 people were arresting on suspicion of terrorism offences in Jammu and Kashmir.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **were arresting**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace **'were arresting' **with **'****were arrested'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• The **past participle refers to an action that was started and completed in the past.**
